highlights.cmb: Bandaranaike International — most trips start here
highlights.colombo: Colombo Fort, Galle Face Green, Pettah markets
highlights.negombo: Handy first or last night, 20 minutes from the airport
highlights.kalpitiya: Kitesurfing lagoon and dolphin boats, May–Oct
highlights.kalutara: Closest beach town to Colombo, big Bodhi temple
highlights.bentota: River safaris and resort beaches, easy first stop
highlights.hikkaduwa: Reef snorkelling and turtles right off the beach
highlights.unawatuna: Calm swimming bay, 15 minutes from Galle
highlights.weligama: Beginner surf bay and stilt fishermen
highlights.mirissa: Whale watching Nov–Apr, easy beach days
highlights.matara: Southern rail terminus, expressway exit for the coast
highlights.hiriketiya: Horseshoe surf bay, quieter than Mirissa
highlights.tangalle: Long empty beaches and Rekawa turtle nesting
highlights.hambantota: Salt pans and the handy southern expressway exit
highlights.tissa: Base town for Yala safaris — early jeep pickups
highlights.yala: Leopard safari — jeep is booked separately
highlights.arugam: Surf season May–Sep, long drive but worth it
highlights.batti: Lagoon town on the east coast, good seafood
highlights.nilaveli: Wide white-sand beach and Pigeon Island snorkelling
highlights.habarana: Elephant safari hub between Minneriya and Kaudulla
highlights.sigiriya: Lion Rock at sunrise, Pidurangala for the view back
highlights.dambulla: Cave temple complex, easy add-on to Sigiriya
highlights.anuradha: Ancient capital — best explored with the driver circling stupas
highlights.kandy: Temple of the Tooth, lake walk, cultural dance show
highlights.hatton: Tea-estate country and the road to Adam’s Peak
highlights.adams: Night climb Dec–May; driver waits nearby
highlights.nuwara: Tea estates, cool nights — pack a jumper
highlights.haputale: Lipton’s Seat sunrise run, best done by car
highlights.ella: Nine Arch Bridge, Little Adam’s Peak, Ravana Falls
highlights.deniyaya: Gateway to Sinharaja rainforest, misty estate roads
